reason: This is the only offered action, and the rover can help make the welcome banner.
expectation: I expect the rover to draw on the banner, perhaps preparing an invitation for the guests.

effect: The banner is ready to place at the fair.
reaction: Kit’s cardboard-hatted whale is a charming addition to the rover’s loops.
reason: Placing the finished banner is the only offered gameplay action and should welcome the guests.
expectation: I expect the banner to be displayed at the flying fair.

effect: The banner is on the grounded cradle, and the dragon and star projector are running; the whale is ready for lift.
reaction: Seeing the earlier attractions working together makes me curious about the flight.
reason: The lift-control key is the only offered gameplay action and should start the flying fair.
expectation: I expect the whale to rise on its tethers while the dragon waves and stars move, though the exact flight remains to be seen.

effect: The whale lifted on its tethers, completing the fair and bringing the dragon and stars into the air together.
reaction: The flight is a satisfying payoff, especially Kit echoing the original invitation to have a go.

mostWorthwhile.text: Starting the flight brought the earlier constructions together in a memorable final scene.

leastWorthwhile.text: Hanging the banner felt more like a necessary transition than a meaningful decision, although it did start the attractions.

surprise.text: I expected the banner to be displayed at the fair, but it went across the grounded cradle while the accessories started up.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though each decision had only one gameplay option, so there was little to figure out.

continue.text: I would choose to continue to see whether Kit gets to operate the fair, though I would hope for more meaningful choices.
